update-manager-free-benefits.title: Some Arc-enabled servers get Update Manager free
update-manager-free-benefits.body: This estimate charges Update Manager for Azure Arc-enabled servers. Microsoft does not charge servers that have Extended Security Updates, sit in a subscription with Defender for Servers Plan 2, or have Windows Server Software Assurance or pay-as-you-go enabled by Azure Arc, so check each server and enter those as covered by a benefit.

citation.source: Azure Update Manager frequently asked questions
citation.quote: Microsoft Defender for Servers Plan 2 is enabled for the subscription that hosts the Azure Arc-enabled server.
